name: Stage 7: two level shapes
description: Oracle fixture: levels 1, 3, 5 ... (as the HUD counts them) play an 8x8 with holes in the corners and the bottom row (the tutorial rows stay full), levels 2, 4 ... a full 7x7; a match is worth 5000 points, so every first match finishes the level; the displayed score keeps up (Board::RollScoreFast), so no level after one ends at once in TIME_UP.
